## r0.2 architecture basis

Approved as the basis for r0.3: separate GEN, UNC, and STD operations; the
selected PTC-to-frozen-MAP conditional-sign route; exact observation-scoped
detector coherence; network-stratified frozen coefficient-mass balance;
complement-symmetric active-domain target mean zero; fixed/relearned
separation; source-bearing claim discipline; the frozen member equation and
response parity; the known-zero-center common-domain second moment; separate
counts, ranks, information, and estimator uncertainty; retry/replacement
separation; plan-controlled persistence; immutable adjacent parents and
successors; narrow unit-`1` STD claim; six byte-bound modules and package-
qualified IDs; and every stated claim prohibition.

## `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-SCOPE-01` - base product scope

Approved. Base v0.1 produces one independent observation-level NOI ensemble
per exact observation and TolTEC array. It defines no cross-observation
randomized ensemble, randomized coadd, or multi-observation GEN route.

Any future route requires a separate method identity, parent, observation
assignment law, coadd operator, coefficient, response, covariance, atomicity,
and lifecycle contract.

## `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-102D-01` - complete finite design

Approved as one indivisible base-v0.1 decision with the following exact
dispositions.

1. The active population in stratum `h` is
   `D_h^+ = {d : beta_d > 0 and exact h(d)=h}`.
2. A zero-mass detector is excluded from the active sign matrix, retained as a
   typed complete-population fact, and unable to affect the frozen map.
3. A zero-total-mass stratum is `not_applicable` to balancing; no ratio is
   evaluated.
4. A positive-mass detector with missing or ambiguous network identity makes
   design resolution unavailable.
5. A singleton active stratum makes the balance design unavailable for every
   `tau_h < 1`; it is neither silently exempted nor cross-balanced.
6. `tau_h` is an exact plan parameter in `[0,1)`, one per active stratum, with
   no default.
7. Candidate signs are independent symmetric Rademacher values before
   conditioning.
8. The target law is uniform over vectors satisfying every active stratum's
   exact balance condition.
9. The selected construction accepts the first candidate satisfying every
   active stratum's exact condition.
10. The retry cap is positive, exact, and preregistered.
11. Failure to resolve within the cap fails the design without tolerance
    relaxation or best-of-failed-candidates fallback.
12. Members are drawn with replacement.
13. Complement pairs are not forced.
14. Exact duplicates remain distinct draws and are reported.
15. Exact complement orbits are represented and reported separately.
16. Equal member weights are `1/N_resolved`.
17. `r_sign` is the uncentered active sign-matrix rank for the known-zero-center
    method. Named projected rank, effective information, and estimator
    uncertainty remain separate.
18. The random generator and canonical key identity are content-bound,
    deterministic, and scheduling-independent.
19. Every applicable plan field is frozen before assignments or member
    products are inspected.

Conditional on successful resolution, finite first-accepted rejection from
the independent symmetric base law is uniform over the admitted sign vectors.
The finite retry cap changes resolution probability, not the conditional
accepted-member law.

## Unchanged unresolved disposition

No new owner decision is supplied here for a reciprocal product. The r0.18
reciprocal decision remains immutable history. Any removal from the ordinary
base bundle or renamed reciprocal successor remains unavailable pending a
